privacy.title: The Agent is optional.
privacy.copy: Undesign is offline-first and does not require an account. Replay runs locally, and no shared provider or key is supplied. Native live requests send your prompt and bounded project context to the endpoint you configure; the key is held in memory only. When enabled, the browser relay supports Meta only and requires your own key for each request; it forwards the key without storing it. Its signed browser session is anonymous and does not verify your identity.
privacy.contextTitle: What the app context can include
privacy.contextCopy: The Agent context is limited to details such as canvas size, selection, layer names, and motion compositions.
